trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

- **Issue:** checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0**, the most recent version that was healthy in production. The rollback rolled out successfully in all three regions and was verified.
- **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failures and the rollback action. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommended follow-up: investigate why v2.3.1 failed health checks so a fix can be validated in staging before redeploying to production.
